task_instance: Fetch the Hugging Face paper page for arXiv ID 1706.03762 ("Attention Is All You Need") as markdown via https://huggingface.co/papers/1706.03762.md and as structured JSON metadata via https://huggingface.co/api/papers/1706.03762, then use that content to produce a short summary of the paper.
blocker_detail: The sandbox's outbound HTTPS proxy rejects CONNECT to huggingface.co and hf.co with 403 (policy denial), as shown by /__agentproxy/status recentRelayFailures ("gateway answered 403 to CONNECT ... host: huggingface.co:443" and "host: hf.co:443"). curl to both the .md paper-page endpoint and the /api/papers/{id} metadata endpoint returned HTTP_STATUS:000 (connection never established). No credentials are required for these public read endpoints per the skill doc, so the blocker is purely network egress policy, not missing auth. This makes the skill's core deliverable (fetching and reading a HF paper page's markdown/metadata) impossible to execute in this runtime.
evidence: cd into work dir; ran: curl -s -o paper.md -w 'HTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}\n' https://huggingface.co/papers/1706.03762.md -> HTTP_STATUS:000 (no file content); curl -s -o paper.json -w 'HTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}\n' https://huggingface.co/api/papers/1706.03762 -> HTTP_STATUS:000 (no file content); curl -sS "$HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status" showed recentRelayFailures entries with kind 'connect_rejected', detail 'gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)' for hosts huggingface.co:443 and hf.co:443, repeated across multiple attempts. No workaround was attempted per the safety rules (no credential use, no alternate egress, no MCP/connector tools used).
